# Plotly.js

Vendored basic bundle, version **4.1.1**, under the MIT license in
`plotly.LICENSE`. No CDN access is needed when viewing an export.

- Bundle: https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-basic-4.1.1.min.js
- License: https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js/blob/v4.1.1/LICENSE
- SHA-256: `99784e3abfb07b142a15e521a439e6d9addceadb3f79553fd24c72774f0649ba`

The page's blue `#4b72b8` and pink `#d6368f` come from the light theme's
`--color-brand-content` and `--color-brand-primary` in
[Furo-ys](https://github.com/YosysHQ/furo-ys/blob/main/src/furo_ys/assets/styles/variables/_colors.scss).
The page layout and CSS are local; the theme itself is not bundled.
